description:
Daydream is a fun and easy way to explore cities around the world. Search for a city to explore, use the shuffle feature to let the app pick one for you, or explore based on your current location! Browse top sights to see and top places to eat for each city. View a specific top sight on a map, read reviews, and explore nearby locations just by tapping. Now powered by the latest Google Places SDK with review summaries powered by Gemini and city summaries powered by Apple Intelligence. Get lost exploring your next destination!

Use Daydream to:

- Explore cities through search or the shuffle button using Google Places APIs
- Scroll through beautiful pictures of top sights and top eateries for each city
- Read reviews for specific points of interest and tap to redirect to the reviewer's page on Google Maps
- Interact with the map by tapping on points of interest to read reviews and get contact/address information
- Toggle the map style using the night mode button for more comfortable viewing at night

I hope you enjoy the app and find a new destination to explore!
keywords: city, discover, travel, tourist, tourism, top sights, top eateries, points of interest, map
